title: Predicating
description: Predicating consumes the potential aperiodic articulation cell and materializes the predication site Φ = E × Π × E around the token-schema and claim-schema the utterance carries (predicating/predication.mts). Cohering a site (`cohere`) yields the saturated cell set and its residue with closed specialization — the residue witness carried, never elided. Transfinite structural regime, quantum dynamical regime.
